levels.description: Before you dive into Data Science you need to know the basics of Linear Algebra, Calculus, Probability, and Statistics.

topics.title: Derivatives
topics.description: Fundamental concept of differential calculus representing rates of change, gradients, and optimization foundations. This topic is needed to understand how loss functions measure prediction error and how model parameters get updated during training.

topics.title: Matrix Multiplication
topics.description: Core linear algebra operation used for transforming feature vectors, linear projections, and neural network layers. This topic is needed to compute dense neural network layer outputs (W * X + b) and process batched dataset matrices efficiently on GPUs.

topics.title: Vectors & Vector Spaces
topics.description: Understanding vectors, dot products, vector norms (L1/L2), projections, and linear independence. This topic is needed to calculate similarity scores between text/image embeddings (cosine similarity) and apply L1/L2 regularization penalties to prevent model overfitting.

topics.title: Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors
topics.description: Spectral decomposition methods essential for understanding Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and dimensionality reduction. This topic is needed to compress high-dimensional feature spaces down to their primary variance axes without losing core information.

topics.title: Partial Derivatives & Gradients
topics.description: Multivariate calculus concepts required to understand gradient descent and loss function optimization. This topic is needed to compute backpropagation gradients across millions of weights simultaneously in deep neural networks.

topics.title: Probability Fundamentals & Bayes' Theorem
topics.description: Conditional probability, independence, joint distributions, and Bayesian inference core to machine learning models. This topic is needed to calculate confidence probabilities for classifications, run Naive Bayes baselines, and understand probabilistic modeling.

topics.title: Descriptive & Inferential Statistics
topics.description: Mean, variance, standard deviation, distributions (Gaussian), hypothesis testing, p-values, and confidence intervals. This topic is needed to standardize feature scales (z-score normalization), evaluate model significance, and spot data leakage during EDA.

levels.description: Master core Python fundamentals alongside essential libraries like NumPy and Pandas for data manipulation and analysis.

topics.title: Data Types & Structures
topics.description: Core primitives and built-in data structures including lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and string manipulation.

topics.title: Control Flow & Iteration
topics.description: Iterative control flow using `for` and `while` loops, list/dict comprehensions, and generator expressions.

topics.title: Conditions & Logic
topics.description: Conditional branching logic using `if`, `elif`, `else` statements, ternary operators, and logical boolean operations.

topics.title: Functions & Scope
topics.description: Modular code reuse using functions, `*args`/`**kwargs`, lambda functions, closures, variable scope, and type hints.

topics.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
topics.description: Classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation, polymorphism, and dunder magic methods (`__init__`, `__repr__`).

topics.title: Environments & Modules
topics.description: Virtual environments (`venv`, `conda`), package management via `pip`, file I/O (JSON/CSV), and module imports.

topics.title: NumPy Numerical Computing
topics.description: N-dimensional arrays (`ndarray`), vectorized math operations, array slicing, reshaping, and broadcasting mechanisms.

topics.title: Pandas Data Manipulation
topics.description: DataFrames, Series, indexing (`loc`/`iloc`), filtering, handling missing values, `groupby` aggregations, and merging.

levels.description: Master foundational supervised and unsupervised algorithms, validation strategies, feature preprocessing, and model evaluation metrics.

topics.title: Linear & Regularized Models
topics.description: Predicting continuous and categorical targets using OLS, Logistic Regression, Ridge (L2), Lasso (L1), and ElasticNet regularization.

topics.title: Feature Engineering & Preprocessing
topics.description: Standardization, min-max scaling, target/one-hot encoding, handling missing data, outlier detection, and pipeline construction.

topics.title: Model Validation & Hyperparameter Tuning
topics.description: Stratified K-Fold cross-validation, train-test splitting, Grid Search, Random Search, and Bayesian optimization.

topics.title: Model Evaluation Metrics
topics.description: Assessing performance using MSE/RMSE, MAE, R², Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC curves, and confusion matrices.

topics.title: Decision Trees & Ensemble Learning
topics.description: Tree mechanics (Gini/Entropy), Bagging (Random Forests), and Gradient Boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost).

topics.title: Clustering & Dimensionality Reduction
topics.description: Unsupervised pattern discovery using K-Means, DBSCAN, Hierarchical Clustering, PCA, and t-SNE / UMAP embeddings.

levels.description: Understand core neural network mechanics, optimization techniques, training dynamics, and PyTorch fundamentals.

topics.title: Perceptrons & Neural Networks
topics.description: Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP), forward propagation, activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, GELU), loss functions, and backpropagation mechanics.

topics.title: Optimization & Regularization Techniques
topics.description: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), Adam, AdamW, learning rate schedulers, Dropout, Batch/Layer Normalization, and weight decay.

topics.title: PyTorch Framework & Tensors
topics.description: Tensor operations, autograd computation graphs, building custom modules with `nn.Module`, DataLoaders, and GPU acceleration.

levels.description: Master specialized deep learning architectures across Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, and modern generative AI.

topics.title: Computer Vision (CV)
topics.description: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), object detection (YOLO), semantic segmentation, Vision Transformers (ViT), and feature backbones (DINOv2).

topics.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
topics.description: Text tokenization, embeddings (Word2Vec, SentenceTransformers), RNNs/LSTMs, Self-Attention mechanisms, and Transformer architectures (BERT, GPT).

topics.title: Generative AI & LLM Systems
topics.description: Large Language Model fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and agentic workflows.

levels.description: Curated selection of essential textbooks, interactive handbooks, and foundational course specializations for Machine Learning and Deep Learning.

topics.title: Yandex Machine Learning Handbook
topics.description: Comprehensive, interactive online textbook covering mathematics, classical machine learning algorithms, and optimization theories.

topics.title: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow (Aurélien Géron)
topics.description: Practical code-first textbook guiding you from Scikit-Learn pipelines to advanced deep learning architectures.

topics.title: Andrew Ng Coursera Specializations
topics.description: Industry-standard Machine Learning and Deep Learning Specializations on Coursera taught by Andrew Ng.
